resources.string: Shows your current or next downtime window.

During your scheduled downtime window, Bedrock watches which app comes to the front and blocks it if it is not on your allowed list. In Instagram and YouTube only, it also checks the layout of the screen to tell an endless feed (Reels, Shorts, the home feed) apart from the rest of the app, so it can block the feed and leave your messages and search working; that part runs at all times, not only during downtime. It never reads message text, captions, or anything you type, and it never looks at the screen of any other app. Nothing it reads is stored or sent anywhere.
